answer.answer: NCEI's marine microplastics database compiles heterogeneous studies with inconsistent units, mesh sizes, and reporting protocols even when nets are nominally the same, so no verified median factor between paired nearby/near-contemporaneous measurements can be cited from the literature. Published comparisons instead report orders-of-magnitude variability without a single consolidated median ratio statistic.
